announcements.headline: EQS-News: Brockhaus Technologies AG: Annual General Meeting approves share buyback of up to €90 million and balance-sheet optimization by a clear majority
announcements.insight: The AGM approved a share buyback following the earlier sale of the Bikeleasing stake. This balance-sheet optimization returns proceeds to shareholders.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Brockhaus Technologies AG: Closing of the sale of the stake in the Bikeleasing Group
announcements.insight: Brockhaus Technologies AG completes the sale of its stake in the Bikeleasing Group. This follows earlier preparations to return proceeds from the disposal.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Brockhaus Technologies AG: Preparation of measures to return proceeds from the sale of the Bikeleasing Group to shareholders
announcements.insight: Brockhaus Technologies AG is preparing measures to return proceeds from the sale of the Bikeleasing Group to shareholders.
